rationale: AREA 3 runs are limited by a port-touching path (reg-to-reg only ~6.1-6.4 ns) and their T_eff rises with target (7.75->6.96, 8.15->7.56, 9.63->7.80, 14.5->9.02), consistent with I/O delays scaling with period, so pin the tightest target; DELAY/AREA 2 runs were reg-to-reg limited at 7.3-9.0 ns. At 7.02 ns slack should stay positive, so max both setup margins to keep repair pushing, with post-GRT timing repair on (those runs also needed 0 hold buffers vs 180-218). Setup limits at ss max-RC and stock RC under-predicted (aes signoff violation, y_huff slew/fanout pins), so use cap213. Slew/cap is far under the bar and DRC always clears, leaving room. Keep md5's synth sizing and timing-driven placement.
